header.title: Our Craft
header.description: Explore the meticulous techniques and natural materials behind every Mumburi creation. A testament to heritage and slow craftsmanship.

sections.title: Clay Works & Jewellery
sections.description: Each piece of jewelry and ceramic vessel is sculpted by hand, drawing inspiration from ancient motifs. We source raw clay locally, allowing the natural minerals to create subtle variations in color and texture after firing.
sections.fact: Fact: Fired at exactly 1050°C to achieve optimal durability while retaining an earthy porosity.

sections.title: Hand-Painted Textiles
sections.description: Our fabrics serve as a canvas for storytelling. Artisans use fine brushes to apply complex, heritage patterns directly onto the woven fabric, ensuring no two pieces are ever exactly alike.
sections.fact: Fact: Colors are derived entirely from plant roots, bark, and crushed minerals.

sections.title: Artisanal Tote Bags
sections.description: Constructed for longevity and adorned with heritage motifs, these totes blend heavy-weight, unbleached canvas with intricate embroidery panels that celebrate traditional craftsmanship in a modern silhouette.
sections.fact: Fact: Every load-bearing seam features our signature hidden double-stitch for unmatched durability.

sections.title: DIY Kits
sections.description: Experience the meditative process of creation at home. Our curated kits provide everything needed to craft your own piece of heritage, connecting you directly to the artisan's journey.
sections.fact: Fact: Each box includes a handwritten 'Artisan's Tip' sharing a secret technique passed down through generations.

sections.title: Bespoke Fabrics
sections.description: We source only the finest, ethically produced fibers. From rough-hewn linens to smooth, tightly woven cottons, the foundation of our work is as considered as the embellishments we apply.

sections.title: Customized Kits
sections.description: Tailored for the dedicated maker. We consult with you to build a bespoke kit, selecting specific patterns, tools, and materials that align with your unique creative vision.
